description: This file defines models and functions for handling employee expense sheets and expense lines in an OpenERP/Odoo module, including creation, copying, state transitions, and invoice generation.

classes.name: hr_expense_expense
classes.description: Model for employee expense sheets, including methods for state transitions and invoice creation.

classes.name: product_product
classes.description: Extension of product.product to add a boolean for expense eligibility.

classes.name: hr_expense_line
classes.description: Model for individual expense lines within an expense sheet, including amount calculation and product onchange logic.

methods.name: _employee_get
methods.description: Retrieve the employee ID associated with the current user.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Create a copy of an expense record with certain fields reset.

methods.name: _amount
methods.description: Calculate total amount for expense or expense lines.

methods.name: _get_currency
methods.description: Determine the default currency for the expense, based on user's company.

methods.name: expense_confirm
methods.description: Transition expense to 'confirm' state and set confirmation date.

methods.name: expense_accept
methods.description: Transition expense to 'accepted' state and set validation date and user.

methods.name: expense_canceled
methods.description: Cancel the expense, setting its state to 'cancelled'.

methods.name: action_invoice_create
methods.description: Generate an invoice from the expense lines and update expense state.

methods.name: onchange_product_id
methods.description: Update expense line fields based on selected product.
